Windows line endings

This file uses CRLF line endings, as Notepad on Windows writes them. The splitter must treat CRLF as one line break and keep it byte for byte.
Second line of the same paragraph.

Новий абзац українською. Він теж закінчується символами CR LF.


Two blank lines above. A lone CRinside a line and a lone LF
inside another.
